title: Genzura mbere yo kubika
readOnly: Incamake yo gusoma gusa. Kanda Hindura kugira ngo uhindure agaciro.
submitHint: Bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho mbere, hanyuma byoherezwe igihe hazaboneka umurongo
submitFailed: Isuzuma ntiryashoboye kubikwa kuri iki gikoresho. Ibyo wanditse biracyari mu nyandiko y'agateganyo — ongera ugerageze.

invalid.title: Hari ibyo wanditse bikeneye gukosorwa
invalid.body: Iyi nyandiko y'agateganyo ntikigera ku isuzuma ry'ibyanditswe. Subira ku ifishi ubikosore mbere yo kubika.

disclaimer: Itegeko ry'urugero gusa — ntiryemejwe n'abaganga. Muganga ni we ufata icyemezo.

flag.title: Igenzura ry'itegeko ry'igerageza
flag.notTriggered: Nta tegeko ry'igerageza ryujujwe. Muganga ashobora no kubisuzuma.
flag.needsPerson: Bikeneye gusuzumwa n'umuntu: itegeko ry'igerageza ntiryashoboye kugenzura ibi bipimo.
flag.preview: Ibibanziriza kuri iki gikoresho. Seriveri izabyemeza nyuma yo guhuza.

detail.title: Isuzuma
detail.notFound: Iri suzuma ntiri kuri iki gikoresho
detail.immutable: Isuzuma ryoherejwe ntirihindurwa. Ikosora ryongerwaho n'impamvu, iby'umwimerere bikagumaho.
detail.awaitingServer: Dutegereje ko seriveri yemeza uko isuzuma rihagaze
detail.noReviewRequested: Ryanditswe. Itegeko ry'igerageza ntiryasabye ko muganga arisuzuma.
detail.needsDecisionBody: Seriveri ifite verisiyo nshya y'iri suzuma. Hitamo icyo ugumana mu gice cyo guhuza.
detail.notAcceptedBody: Seriveri y'igerageza ntiyemeye iri suzuma ({{code}}). Riguma kuri iki gikoresho.
